meta.title: Model picker
meta.description: Adds a collapsible, searchable model chooser to the composer's model menu. When a profile has many providers and a hundred models the built-in menu lays every row out flat and finding one gets slow; this plugin groups models by provider, folds each group, and matches model names, model ids and provider names from one search field (several words are ANDed, whole-phrase hits rank first). Usage: click the composer's model button, then the first row, "All models (grouped by provider)", then fold or search and pick. Selection goes through the same shared modelDirectories service, so the composer chip, the /model popup and this panel always agree. The panel footer switches the current model's reasoning effort. Because it extends the built-in menu instead of replacing it, the Agent Teams switch, provider badges and price hints other plugins contribute keep working — the built-in control still renders those slots. Keyboard: arrows move the highlight, Enter selects, Escape closes, Tab stays inside. IME composition is respected. No configuration fields.
